about: Recall set for the e-commerce library: owner-style questions, each labelled with the card that answers it. Written from the cards themselves (never from bench briefs), in other words than the card uses, with short forms (ROAS, AOV, COD, 3PL) where an owner would use them. test/ecom-knowledge-reach.test.ts reports Recall@5 and MRR with and without aliases and module routing.
